PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
Data Governance and Data Stewardship professional with 7+ years of experience working on master data, CRM governance, data quality, 
and cross-functional data operations. Experienced in managing HCP and HCO datasets across Salesforce, Veeva CRM, and IQVIA platforms 
within Life Sciences environments. 
Skilled in data quality management, data validation, root cause analysis, SLA governance, metadata management, and master data 
processes. Hands-on experience in resolving data inconsistencies, managing DCR lifecycle, maintaining affiliation hierarchies, and 
improving CRM data accuracy through governance controls and validation rules. 
Worked closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Compliance, and business teams to support data governance initiatives, audit readiness, 
reporting accuracy, and operational decision-making. Familiar with data profiling, data reconciliation, KPI reporting, governance 
workflows, and enterprise data quality processes.
